## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run test:package` when packaging, CLI initialization, or bundled assets changed
- [ ] `npm run test:docker` when runner construction or container execution changed
- [ ] No credentials, generated results, telemetry, or local agent settings are included

List any additional manual or integration verification.

## Integrity impact

Describe changes to security boundaries, reproducibility, verification evidence,
profile fidelity, benchmark methodology, or stored result compatibility. Write
"None" when none apply.
